absences: No vendor milestone dated 2026-10-31 through 2026-11-03 was found for any shipped or listed vendor. Searches with dated queries returned no November 2026 vendor item, and the index may lag. Re-check the company news pages (radiantnuclear.com/blog, Antares, Valar, Aalo, NANO Nuclear IR) before the next run.

Radiant Kaleidos: fueling date not published after the readiness review; criticality not reported as of the 2026-10-29 release. The shipped 'Q3 target passed' wording is inferred from the absence of fueling, not stated in any fetched page.
Deployable Energy: the 2027 DOME window start is disputed (CEO said May 2027; NRIC call says next slot begins July 2027). Date of the NRIC notice is not verified.
Westinghouse eVinci: withdrawal from the 2027 DOME slot is reported by NEI Magazine (dated 2026-10-05, before the window) and by no primary NRIC or Westinghouse page; the reason is unverified.
Last Energy PWR-5: no criticality report found; latest local report (Sept 2026) says construction continues. Final DSA date not verified.
Natura MSR-1: no fuel-loading or operating-licence news found after the Sept 18 FLiBe delivery.
General Atomics GA-TES: no firm Fort Hood deployment date; sources disagree on 5 MWe vs 20 MWe sizing for that site.
Valar: Utah BLM approval of Project Beehive not found; Nvidia 30 MW claim not re-checked (no fetched primary source).
Terra Innovatum: NRC topical-report evaluations expected by October 2026 not found; the Aug 10 readiness-assessment item comes from one aggregator and could not be checked against a primary source.
Steady Energy, NANO KRONOS, Aalo, Blue Energy: no milestone dated after 2026-10-30 found. Blue Energy is 300 MW class and out of scope.

checks.claim: DOME campaign: criticality through 150 h unattended run; the Q3 target passed and fueling waits on DOE's Readiness Review, which has no set date
checks.evidence: Radiant release dated 2026-10-29 (DSA approval for full-power operation) says: "Following successful completion of the review, Radiant will fuel Kaleidos", and gives no date for fueling or the start of the five-phase campaign. The release does not itself say the Q3 target passed; that is inferred from fueling not having happened as of 2026-10-29.
